issues.quote: | A8 | CRM activity read down or absent | Rep calls from VinSolutions, then clicks "Handled elsewhere" | Leaves the queue; click shown per owner; excluded from the median | R2 [E13] |
issues.concern: CRM activity is read nowhere today, and my people answer out of VinSolutions. So on day one at every rooftop like the requesting one, every customer a rep already called or texted from the CRM sits in Unanswered until someone comes back to the console and clicks. That is the exact cross-check on about 600 leads a month the used car manager said 'there's no way that these guys would do'. Nobody will click, the queue fills with answered customers, the badge stops meaning anything, and by week two my managers ignore it. At the requesting store it gets worse: no Mine and no texts on day one, so the first thing he gets is a longer list he has to clean by hand.

In Rollout, turn sales on at the requesting rooftop only when the VinSolutions read is live or its manager agrees to the team-view-and-click version, confirmed by the CSM; and use Phase 0 to state the expected clicks per rep per day before day one.

issues.quote: CRM activity after `since` (sales, where read); a booking or RO opened (service, where read)
issues.concern: Not every CRM touch is a person answering my customer. Spyne itself pushes into VinSolutions as 'AI SPYNE', and the CRM fires its own auto-responders and drip emails. Count those and the episode clears the moment it opens, the customer drops out of the queue unanswered, and nobody finds out. Same on the drive: if Vini books the service appointment, that is not an advisor answering the question the customer was handed off with. A silent false clear is the worst failure here because it looks like the system worked.

issues.concern: Once per episode is once per customer, not once per manager. At a store doing about 600 leads a month, a busy Saturday puts a stack of texts on my sales manager's phone. He mutes the number by Sunday and the one escalation that mattered goes with it. The PRD knows this: the per-recipient cap is in Open question 4, but it is not in the requirement or the criteria.

Add an acceptance criterion for the cap: ten episodes escalate in five minutes, one recipient gets one text.

issues.quote: - Escalation N minutes and recipients per department: no default; no escalation until set.
